description: React component for a dialog handling wrong assignment reports, including sub-components for routing info, assignee selection, and additional notes, with hooks for state and API interactions.

classes.name: RoutingInfoSection
classes.description: Displays routing reason, who booked, and who received the booking, with copy-to-clipboard functionality.

classes.name: AdditionalNotesSection
classes.description: Form section for entering additional notes related to the wrong assignment report.

classes.name: AssigneeSection
classes.description: Form section for selecting or entering the correct assignee.

classes.name: WrongAssignmentDialog
classes.description: Main dialog component for reporting wrong assignment, integrating sub-components and handling form submission and API interactions.

methods.name: RoutingInfoSection
methods.description: Renders routing info with copy functionality.

methods.name: AdditionalNotesSection
methods.description: Renders textarea for additional notes with validation.

methods.name: AssigneeSection
methods.description: Renders assignee selection input, either dropdown or email input.

methods.name: WrongAssignmentDialog
methods.description: Handles dialog open/close, form submission, and API calls for reporting wrong assignment.
